channel.description: Field notes on AI-powered product management, game production workflows, and building in public.

item.title: Building in Public — Why I'm Opening the Scribe's Archive
item.description: Six years of shipping games taught me that the best production knowledge lives in war stories nobody writes down. So I'm writing mine down — AI workflows, pipeline fixes, and the messy middle of making games.

item.title: An AI Copilot for Game Producers — What Actually Sticks
item.description: I spent a quarter running LLMs against real production work — standups, risk registers, vendor threads. Here's the honest scorecard: three workflows that stuck, two that failed, and the rule I use to tell them apart.
